    42	
    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is

   176	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]
   177	    (S : Quantum.Measurement Γ ι) (hS : Measurement.IsProjective S)
   178	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   179	    ∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.effect g) ψ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   181	    fun g => (hS g).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   182	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
   183	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, S.sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   184	
   185	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   186	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   187	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   188	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   189	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   190	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   191	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   192	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   193	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧

   199	  by_contra! h

   208	      simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01]
   209	    · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h0, Ne.symm h1,

   213	/-- A nonzero specialized coefficient outside the scalar-linear monomials
   214	certifies nonzero difference from every `alpha * b + beta * c` simultaneously.
   215	This is the common good-base-point criterion needed before sandwich weighting. -/
   216	private theorem specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   217	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)
   218	    (he0 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1) (he1 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1)
   219	    (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) (b c : F) :
   220	    MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p ≠
   221	      MvPolynomial.C b * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   222	  intro h
   223	  apply hu

   228	/-- Schwartz--Zippel in the uniform-average notation used by the coefficient

   230	theorem avg_eval_eq_le {n D : ℕ} (p r : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)
   231	    (hne : p ≠ r) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ D) (hr : r.totalDegree ≤ D) :
   232	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   233	      (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u p = MvPolynomial.eval u r then 1 else 0) ≤
   234	      (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
   235	  have hsz := Preliminaries.schwartzZippel_totalDegree hne hp hr

   237	    _ = (Preliminaries.polynomialAgreementProbability n F p r : ℝ) := by

   239	        Preliminaries.polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
   240	    _ ≤ (((D : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card F : ℚ≥0) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsz

   246	private theorem avg_specialization_eq_linear_le_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   247	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)
   248	    (he0 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1) (he1 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1)
   249	    (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) (b c : F) :

   251	      if MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p) =
   252	        v 0 * b + v 1 * c then 1 else 0) ≤
   253	      (max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) := by
   254	  have hdeg : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree :=

   257	      MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2)).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
   258	    apply (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans
   259	    apply max_le
   260	    · exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by simp)
   261	    · exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by simp)
   262	  simpa [mul_comm] using
   263	    avg_eval_eq_le _ _ (specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff p e he0 he1 u hu b c)

   266	/-- The first polynomial-image estimate for the diagonal sandwich, with
   267	explicit degrees of the scalar polynomial and its base-point coefficients.
   268	A single nonzero nonlinear coefficient supplies a common exceptional set for
   269	all outcomes. Neither a uniform-collision premise nor an outcome-count loss
   270	occurs. The nested polynomial ring is the coefficient expansion used at paper
   271	lines 1311--1316; this theorem does not assert the later block-separation step. -/
   272	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   273	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   274	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   275	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   276	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   277	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   278	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   279	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
